_doc: itemId -> { lockedBy, note }. Populated during route authoring (Tasks 17-24).

weapon-ruins-greatsword.note: The Misbegotten Warrior + Crucible Knight duo at Redmane Castle is replaced while the Festival is active; defeat them first (reaching Altus or progressing Ranni auto-triggers the Festival).

weapon-bolt-of-gransax.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
weapon-bolt-of-gransax.note: On the giant spear in the Avenue plaza of the Royal Capital; gone in the Ashen Capital.

whetblade-sanctified-whetblade.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
whetblade-sanctified-whetblade.note: Royal Capital only; unlocks Holy/Lightning affinities. Collect before Farum Azula.

key-item-golden-order-principia.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
key-item-golden-order-principia.note: Prayerbook in the Fortified Manor, western Leyndell; Royal Capital only.

talisman-blessed-dew-talisman.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
talisman-blessed-dew-talisman.note: Chest on the Divine Bridge behind the Golem; Royal Capital only.

weapon-sword-of-milos.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
weapon-sword-of-milos.note: Dung Eater's moat invasion does not occur in the Ashen Capital.

key-item-weathered-dagger.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
key-item-weathered-dagger.note: Found in the Royal Capital; give to D to advance Fia's questline.

talisman-rotten-winged-sword-insignia.lockedBy: Betray path at Elphael (red summon sign) or incomplete Millicent questline
talisman-rotten-winged-sword-insignia.note: From Millicent's corpse on the assist path (gold sign vs her four sisters at Elphael). Mutually exclusive with Millicent's Prosthesis.

key-item-miquella-s-needle.lockedBy: Betray path or incomplete Millicent questline
key-item-miquella-s-needle.note: Use the Unalloyed Gold Needle on Millicent's Scarlet Aeonia after assisting her and defeating Malenia; used in Placidusax's arena to undo the Frenzied Flame.

talisman-millicent-s-prosthesis.lockedBy: Assist path at Elphael (gold summon sign) or incomplete Millicent questline
talisman-millicent-s-prosthesis.note: From Millicent's corpse on the betray path (red sign). Mutually exclusive with Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.

talisman-flock-s-canvas-talisman.lockedBy: Not completing Millicent's questline to either conclusion
talisman-flock-s-canvas-talisman.note: From Gowry's corpse after Millicent's questline concludes (either path).
